trace_quality.metadata_note: All non-RX stdout lines, including histograms and END/maps, are retained verbatim. Absence of a warning is not proof of zero probe overhead or complete hardware visibility.

interpretation.preceding_irq: The most recent IRQ66 entry recorded when this NAPI poll began. It is not a packet-arrival timestamp or proven causal IRQ; one IRQ/poll can serve multiple packets and polls may run without a fresh IRQ.
interpretation.poll_to_gro: Elapsed time inside the recorded poll before this packet's napi_gro_receive_entry, when context exists. It is not pre-interrupt residence or wire delay.
interpretation.arithmetic: Intervals are differences between Linux monotonic fields in the same RX row. No cross-host timestamp subtraction, IRQ subtraction from RTT, or residual correction is performed.
interpretation.validity: Missing readiness/END/config, malformed rows, recognized observer warnings, or selected-counter mismatch mark the trace invalid. Matched rows remain inspectable; statistics from an invalid trace do not establish a complete or unbiased capture.
interpretation.missing_context: Zero or negative context values and negative intervals remain in exact rows with flags. Unavailable intervals are omitted rather than assigned zero.
interpretation.cohorts: Joins start from all interface turnaround cycles, not only complete Linux TX cycles. Payload-size cohorts describe the largest-acked outgoing carrier; 37-byte carriers are distinct from 1126-byte application-size carriers.
interpretation.selection: Only unique exact identity, payload length, and same-direction UDP port matches enter results. Duplicate identities choose no winner. These are selected ACK observations, not independent IRQs or representative latency quantiles.
